note: Options whose internal ID names a shape the customer-facing LABEL contradicts, where each side carries a shape the other does not. A conflict needs a difference in BOTH directions - otherwise "Round Point 7.0 cm" flags itself, since round and pointed contradict but the id and label both carry both words and agree perfectly. Confirmed real on ext-pointed and ext-curved, whose DESCRIPTIONS had been written from the id and would have generated the wrong shape.
